title: Machine Hearing: Can Audio LLMs Generalize Beyond Human Auditory Perception?
abstract: arXiv:2611.10693v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal LLMs have made remarkable progress in perceiving the physical world, while their perceptual scope remains largely human-centric, focusing on what humans can directly see or hear. This progress raises the prospect of perception beyond human limits, such as extending hearing to sounds that are inaudible to humans. More broadly, the physical world is full of waves, vibrations, and oscillations, only a small fraction of which are directly audible to humans. This invites the extension of multimodal LLMs toward a broader form of machine hearing, which remains largely underexplored. To investigate this direction, we introduce the Machine Hearing Benchmark (MHB), comprising 6,128 instances across 13 tasks and seven domains. MHB spans highly heterogeneous input regimes, with sampling rates from approximately $10^{-5}$ to $10^6$ Hz, sequence lengths from $10^1$ to $10^6$ samples, and both single- and multi-channel inputs. translated_title: 机器听觉：音频大语言模型能否超越人类听觉感知进行泛化？
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型在感知物理世界方面取得了显著进展，但其感知范围仍主要局限于以人类为中心，聚焦于人类能够直接看到或听到的事物。这一进展引发了对超越人类极限的感知的展望，例如将听觉扩展到人类无法听见的声音。更广泛地说，物理世界充满了波、振动和振荡，其中只有一小部分能被人类直接听到。这促使人们将多模态大语言模型扩展为更广泛形式的机器听觉，而这一方向在很大程度上仍待探索。为研究这一方向，我们引入了机器听觉基准（Machine Hearing Benchmark, MHB），包含跨13个任务和7个领域的6,128个实例。MHB涵盖了高度异构的输入模式，采样率从约10^-5到10^6 Hz，序列长度从10^1到10^6个样本，并同时包括单通道和多通道输入。
tldr: 提出了机器听觉基准（MHB），通过涵盖7个领域、13个任务、采样率跨越约10^-5至10^6 Hz的6,128个实例，系统评估音频大语言模型能否超越人类听觉范围实现更广泛的机器听觉泛化能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces the Machine Hearing Benchmark (MHB), comprising 6,128 instances across 13 tasks and seven domains with sampling rates from ~10^-5 to 10^6 Hz, to evaluate whether audio LLMs can generalize beyond human auditory perception toward broader machine hearing.
